name: scim-mock
description: A SCIM 2.0 service provider (RFC 7643, RFC 7644): Users, Groups, filter, PATCH and ETags, for testing user provisioning.

settings.name: error_status
settings.description: HTTP status every SCIM request is answered with instead of its normal result; 0 turns it off. Values 1 to 99 are refused.

settings.name: latency_ms
settings.description: Milliseconds every SCIM request waits before it is answered; 0 turns it off.

settings.name: rate_limit
settings.description: Requests the scope answers in each 60-second window; the next one gets 429 with Retry-After. 0 turns it off. Setting it or resetting the scope restarts the window.
